limitations: This interpreter is not desktop Excel or LibreOffice. Dropdown UI, Excel row-sort behavior, visual clipping and native Excel save/reopen remain pending.
The saved/reopened engine output is a disposable values-only test export. Delivered workbooks retain normal Excel formulas and automatic full recalculation; no fabricated cached values are inserted.

The interpreter can retain a preassembled entirely blank lookup range when individual blank cells are overridden. Notes and sorting are therefore tested using physically saved filled copies, not blank-cell override assumptions.
